mapper.sql: select t.id, t.task_no, t.work_type_id, t.work_method_id, coalesce(wt.dict_label, cast(t.work_type_id as char)) as work_type_name, coalesce(wm.dict_label, cast(t.work_method_id as char)) as work_method_name, coalesce(t.area_id, l.area_id) as area_id, t.location_id, a.park_id, p.park_name, a.area_name, l.location_name, concat_ws(' ', p.park_name, a.area_name, l.location_name) as region_full_name, t.description, t.photo_urls, t.create_by_id, coalesce(cu.nick_name, cu.user_name, t.create_by_id) as create_by_name, t.operator_id, coalesce(( select group_concat(od.dict_label order by find_in_set(od.dict_value, replace(t.operator_id, ' ', '')) separator ',') from sys_dict_data od where od.dict_type = 'ylm_agri_operator' and find_in_set(od.dict_value, replace(t.operator_id, ' ', '')) > 0 ), t.operator_id) as operator_name, t.create_time, t.start_time, t.end_time, t.remark, t.agri_task_a, t.agri_task_b, t.agri_task_c, t.agri_task_d from ylm_agri_task t left join location l on t.location_id = l.location_id left join area a on coalesce(t.area_id, l.area_id) = a.area_id left join park p on a.park_id = p.park_id left join sys_user cu on t.create_by_id = cast(cu.user_id as char) left join sys_dict_data wt on wt.dict_type = 'ylm_agri_work_type' and wt.dict_value = cast(t.work_type_id as char) left join sys_dict_data wm on wm.dict_type = 'ylm_agri_work_method' and wm.dict_value = cast(t.work_method_id as char)

where.if: and concat_ws(' ', p.park_name, a.area_name, l.location_name) like concat('%', #{regionFullName}, '%')

mapper.insert: insert into ylm_agri_task (task_no, work_type_id, work_method_id, area_id, location_id, description, photo_urls, create_by_id, operator_id, create_time, start_time, end_time, remark, agri_task_a, agri_task_b, agri_task_c, agri_task_d) values (#{taskNo}, #{workTypeId}, #{workMethodId}, #{areaId}, #{locationId}, #{description}, #{photoUrls}, #{createById}, #{operatorId}, sysdate(), #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{remark}, #{agriTaskA}, #{agriTaskB}, #{agriTaskC}, #{agriTaskD})
mapper.select: select p.park_id as parkId, p.park_name as parkName, a.area_id as areaId, a.area_name as areaName, l.location_id as locationId, l.location_name as locationName from park p left join area a on p.park_id = a.park_id left join location l on a.area_id = l.area_id order by p.park_id, a.area_id, l.location_id
select task_no from ylm_agri_task where task_no like concat(#{prefix}, '%') order by task_no desc
select dict_label as dictLabel, dict_value as dictValue from sys_dict_data where dict_type = #{dictType} and status = '0' order by dict_sort
